newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields fall on Bulgaria 1-,4-week discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on Bulgaria 1-,4-week discount T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell at Wednesday's auctions of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry one-week and four-week discount T-bills, central bank figures showed.
The average yields to maturity of the two issues were 1.62 percent and 9.11 percent, respectively, down from 1.69 and 10.69 percent at Tuesday's auctions.
Bids were received for a total of 73.069 billion levs of T-bills for today's auctions but the ministry approved bids for 53.118 billion levs worth of paper.
The issues were offered with par values of 25 billion levs and 40 billion levs respectively and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 25,000 million levs 40,000 million levs
Bids received 13,117.6 million levs 59,951.6 million levs
Bids approved 13,117.6 million levs 40,000 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 1.62 pct 9.11 pct
